name: ms365_list_my_events
title: List my Outlook calendar events
description:
List the signed-in user's Outlook calendar events in a time window, through their connected Microsoft 365 account (Microsoft Graph /me/calendarView, Calendars.Read), ordered by start time. Times are UTC.
Returns: from, to, count and events (subject, start, end, location, organizer, online, url).
Inputs (none required): start (ISO 8601 date or time; default now; no time zone means UTC); end (ISO 8601; default start + days); days (window length when end is not given, 1-92; default 7); limit (1-100; default 25).
Runs only for a signed-in SAJHA user; when the account is not linked, or lacks the scope, the call returns a request to connect it with a link instead of a result.
Example: {"start": "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z", "days": 5, "limit": 50}

days.description: Window length when end is not given

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Acts as the caller: needs a linked Microsoft 365 account with Calendars.Read.
